definition.title: Key personnel
definition.description: Two outside. Two detained. Bring all four home.
definition.intro: Voss: the mandate is safe with Mara. They raided the safehouse while Morrow and Sable were scouting the handover. Now they want the mandate for Vale and Rook. We are collecting our people instead. I traced a remote gate console on the west service street.

briefing.lead: They have mistaken our people for negotiable assets.
briefing.body: The extraction from the authorisation works succeeded. Hours later, a safehouse raid took Vale and Rook alive. Morrow and Sable must free them from separate cells and extract all four at VAN. Losing any operative fails this rescue. The mandate stays with Mara.

routes.title: One console, two partners
routes.body: Give Morrow the maintenance KIT. Send Sable to the west remote console and hold INTAKE while Morrow passes the amber gate. Stop inside, select Sable and switch to CELLS: the amber gate closes and the blue gate opens. Select Morrow again to enter holding. Selection never releases a held circuit. The operator cannot shoot while working. RADIO does not power these locks.

routes.title: Free them, then release the route
routes.body: Keep a partner holding CELLS while another works the local VALE and ROOK locks for two seconds each. Door safety cannot replace remote power. Each freed teammate becomes controllable and can recover their own weapon and dressing at GEAR; both can also leave unarmed. Once both are free, use EXIT inside detention to latch both gates open, then rally everyone to VAN. The register is optional. Blown cover still permits a coordinated armed rescue.

landmarks.label: Maintenance identity
landmarks.detail: Morrow can conceal a pistol. Take the uniform before entering intake.

landmarks.label: Hold intake circuit
landmarks.detail: Hold the amber gate open. One operative must stay here. Switching to CELLS closes INTAKE.

landmarks.label: Hold cell circuit
landmarks.detail: Same console: power the blue gate and local cell locks. The operator must stay here while a partner frees the prisoners.

landmarks.label: Human dispatch relay
landmarks.detail: Stops reinforcement calls. It has no effect on the wired detention gates.

landmarks.label: Free Vale
landmarks.detail: Local release: two seconds while a different operative holds CELLS. Vale joins unarmed.

landmarks.label: Free Rook
landmarks.detail: Local release: two seconds while a different operative holds CELLS. Rook joins unarmed.

landmarks.label: Confiscated equipment
landmarks.detail: Each freed prisoner can recover their own weapon and field dressing. Optional for extraction.

landmarks.label: Emergency gate release
landmarks.detail: After freeing both prisoners, latch both gates open so the remote operator can leave.

landmarks.label: Detention register
landmarks.detail: Optional evidence. Rescue the crew first; carrying it occupies both hands.

landmarks.label: Bring everyone home
landmarks.detail: Free both prisoners, use EXIT, then bring all four operatives here. Confiscated equipment and the register are optional.

note: Too easy to sneak in and release the captured operatives. Add a patrolling guard so that you at least have to time your escape from the cells.
